bambuddy.title: Connect Bambuddy
bambuddy.intro: Step 2 of 2: tell Reprintbuddy where Bambuddy is and which key to use.
bambuddy.step_user: In Bambuddy, create a user named "reprintbuddy".
bambuddy.step_permission: Give that user the permission "Print without review".
bambuddy.step_key: For that user, create an API key with the permissions "Read Status" and "Manage Queue".
bambuddy.review_confirmed: The Bambuddy user has the permission "Print without review".
bambuddy.review_required: Please confirm that the Bambuddy user has the permission "Print without review".
bambuddy.fields_required: Please fill in the address, the user name and the API key.
bambuddy.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https:// and have a valid host and port (1 to 65535).
bambuddy.reason.unauthorized: The API key was not accepted by Bambuddy.
bambuddy.reason.forbidden: The API key does not have the rights Reprintbuddy needs ("Read Status", "Manage Queue").
bambuddy.reason.unreachable: Could not reach Bambuddy at this address. Check the address and that Bambuddy is running.
bambuddy.reason.not_bambuddy: The address answered, but it does not look like Bambuddy.
overview.title: Overview
overview.empty: Nothing here yet. The overview is built in a later step.
settings.title: Settings
settings.bambuddy_hint: Changes are saved only if the connection check succeeds.
settings.secret_stored: A value is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it; enter a new value to replace it.
settings.restart_needed: Changes to address, port and HTTPS take effect after Reprintbuddy has been restarted.
settings.https_hint: Paste the certificate and private key as text or upload the files. Leave both empty to keep what is stored.
settings.tls_none: No certificate stored: Reprintbuddy serves plain HTTP.
settings.tls_remove: Remove certificate and private key (serve plain HTTP)
settings.invalid_port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535.
settings.invalid_pem: The certificate or the private key could not be read. Expected PEM text, at most 64 KB.
settings.tls_pair_required: Please provide the certificate and the private key together.
settings.key_required_new_address: The address has changed. Please enter the API key again: a stored key is never sent to a new address.
settings.host_unbindable: This machine cannot listen on this address. Check it: saving an unusable address would lock you out.
bambuddy.key_invalid: The API key contains characters that are not allowed (only visible ASCII characters, no spaces or line breaks). Please copy it again.
error.forbidden.title: Not allowed
error.forbidden.message: This action was not allowed. If you were signed in, your session may have expired: reload the page and try again.
error.not_found.title: Page not found
error.not_found.message: There is nothing at this address.
error.host.title: Address not allowed
error.host.message: While Reprintbuddy is being set up, open it by its IP address (for example http://<server-address>:8080) instead of a host name.
error.generic.title: Something went wrong
error.generic.message: The request could not be completed.
settings.privileged_port: Saved. Note: ports below 1024 need extra rights and the service does not run as root, so it probably cannot use this port. Changes take effect after Reprintbuddy has been restarted; if it does not start, set another port with the command set-port.
